description: This PHP class defines the entity for OAuth refresh tokens within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It maps to a database table and includes properties like token strings, expiry, and revocation status, with getters and setters for each property.

classes.name: OAuthRefreshToken
classes.description: Entity class representing OAuth2 refresh tokens, mapped to the database table 'ohrm_oauth2_refresh_token'. It manages refresh token data, access tokens, expiry, and revocation status.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the refresh token.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the refresh token.

methods.name: getAccessToken
methods.description: Returns the access token associated with this refresh token.

methods.name: setAccessToken
methods.description: Sets the access token associated with this refresh token.

methods.name: getExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Returns the expiry DateTimeImmutable in UTC timezone.

methods.name: isRevoked
methods.description: Checks if the token has been revoked.

methods.name: setRevoked
methods.description: Sets the revoked status of the token.
